usedFor: Paystack processes payments and subscriptions and Calendly books calls, so “Cancelled Subscription” can feed “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Cancelled Subscription” in Paystack, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation is the best moment to offer a call, and the link is created then.

watchOut: “Cancelled Subscription” is polling and covers recent cancellations, so the link follows after a scheduled check.
